milestones.title: Sprint 1: Spec and vendors
milestones.description: Thu Oct 8 to Wed Oct 14. Goal: Spec tagged v1, the handoff size limit measured, and every vendor step that waits on others started.

milestones.title: Sprint 2: Fork point
milestones.description: Thu Oct 29 to Fri Oct 30. Goal: Chi è? launched and tagged, and the new repo holds both games in the new layout with CI green.

milestones.title: Sprint 3: Merged site on staging
milestones.description: Mon Nov 2 to Fri Nov 6. Goal: One login and the language picker work on staging with both games, the handoff is built, and the playtest has run.

milestones.title: Sprint 4: Fix and launch
milestones.description: Mon Nov 9 to Fri Nov 13. Goal: Must-fix findings closed, migration rehearsed, and parlaplay.games live with redirects and the handoff.
